africa.text: Nigeria’s Guardian reports the 2027 NDC initiative to curb vote sabotage by recruiting polling agents nationwide.
Algeria celebrates its legacy, promoting unity from its revolutionary past to a future of communal living.

europe.text: Trump says a new president is needed in Ukraine amid diesel dispute with Zelensky.
Former UN judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel, sparking debate over Israel's protection policies.
Zaporizhzhia attack kills 12; Zelensky blames Putin for thanking Trump.

latin-america.text: A 6.2‑magnitude earthquake struck near Arequipa, Peru, causing minor damage and prompting evacuations.
International lawyer Fatou Bensouda condemned new US sanctions on the ICC, warning they could hinder justice for crimes in Latin America.

oceania.text: Trump declares “time for a new president in Ukraine,” accusing Zelenskyy of corruption in a fiery press conference.
The All Blacks dominate Australia, scoring 50 points to retain the Bledisloe Cup in a one‑sided test match.
Day two of the South Africa vs Australia men's cricket Test sees South Africa pulling ahead with a strong batting performance.

middle-east.text: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas announced plans for presidential and legislative elections in September 2027, urging unity among factions.
Yemen’s fighting intensifies from Bab al‑Mandab to Taiz as Trump considers direct strikes against Houthi targets.

asia.text: Delhi protests: Mamata, Kejriwal and 7,000 demonstrators released, while CJP leaders remain detained.
Indian police arrest “cockroach” leaders ahead of a planned protest against the Election Commission.
Actor Imran Khan joins hundreds detained at a Mumbai rally supporting the CJP.
One year after the Gaza ceasefire, most promised humanitarian aid remains undelivered.

north-america.text: Civil Protection orders now cover “Simon” in four U.S. states, granting emergency safeguards amid rising threats.
The U.S. Supreme Court is divided on sentencing guidelines when both offender and victim are Indigenous, sparking legal debate.
OECD data reveals North America’s health outcomes lag behind peers, prompting calls for policy reforms.
